name: Turn Guard
description: Publishes an agent's finished briefs to a host folder, and can make listed agents answer one turn at a time.

briefsDir.label: Briefs folder
briefsDir.help: Absolute host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing.

publishedPathPrefix.label: Published path prefix
publishedPathPrefix.help: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path.

queue.label: One-at-a-time agents
queue.help: Agents whose inbound turns run one at a time; the rest wait their turn.

briefsDir.description: Absolute host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing. No default. A relative path leaves publish_brief unregistered.

publishedPathPrefix.description: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path. Unset: the host path is returned.

maxBriefChars.description: Longest brief publish_brief accepts, in characters.

queue.description: Makes listed agents answer one inbound turn at a time. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess for before_agent_run and agent_end.

agents.description: Agent ids that answer one turn at a time. Empty or unset: nothing is queued.

maxWaitMs.description: Longest a turn waits for its agent, in milliseconds. Past it the sender gets busyText. OpenClaw aborts an inbound message not adopted within 300000 ms of its claim.

maxWaiting.description: Most turns waiting per agent. A turn arriving at a full line gets busyText at once. Unset: no limit; maxWaitMs still bounds every wait.

startGraceMs.description: How long a turn that was let through may take to start a run, in milliseconds, before the agent is freed. Covers commands and claimed or aborted turns, which start none.

maxRunMs.description: A run that reports no end frees the agent after this long, in milliseconds. Set it above the agent's longest run.

rest.description: Optional pause between turns after a busy stretch. Unset: no pause.

afterBusyShare.description: Busy means the agent's runs filled more than this share of windowMs.

windowMs.description: Window the share is measured over, in milliseconds.

pauseMs.description: Pause before the next turn while busy, in milliseconds. A waiting turn still starts before its maxWaitMs.

busyText.description: Reply to a turn that is not queued or waited too long.
